{{Quote|Fresh-err-hot gorak! Skewered, fried, then roasted to perfection! Food that'll leave you thinking about it for hours!|A vendor|<ref name="KOTFE6">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=6}}</ref>}}
'''Gorak''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bird that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Roast gorak bird was sometimes cooked in [[malla petal]]s.

A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified gorak vendor|vendor]] sold gorak on [[Asylum]]. Shortly after their [[Rescue of the Outlander|rescue]], [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] witnessed a [[Unidentified gorak customer|customer]] request four orders of gorak from him.<ref name="KOTFE6" />
